## Update 1.2.6 Beta 3

**New Features:**
* Switching Receive Beta Updates smoothly changes the latest version, date, release notes and install button

**Bug Fixes:**
* Resetting no longer crashes the first time Feather reopens
* Resetting sources, apps, certificates or caches now happens right away without restarting Feather
* Reset Settings and Reset All close Feather cleanly, so it opens normally next time
* KravaSign uses its official website and logo
